comment: Mehkari is the GOAT. Material is confusing at first, but it becomes straight forward as you review and ask questions. He's also always available for extra help / questions /support whether it be in person or over email.

He's a really great guy. He's accessible outside of class, funny, and will sit down and talk things out with you if you're having a tough time. But I didn't find his lectures helpful at all. HW is basically impossible unless you work with others and go to extra study sessions on Sundays. But really great guy.

Saif is a great professor who genuinely cares about his students. He slightly rushed the hard content at the end of the semester, but is always happy to help outside of class and clearly wants his students to succeed.
Best business professor at the University of Richmond.

I love this professor so much. One of the most understanding people at Richmond willing to help with practically anything, even outside of economics. It is very clear that he knows what he is doing and will go out of his way to explain things to us. He even planned study schedules and bought us snacks for finals.

Genuinely such a nice professor and overall person. He truly cares about his students and wants to make sure everyone in the class understands each concept before moving on. If you would like to study business at UR, I would highly recommend the Business Endeavor Program because you get to learn from amazing professors like Saif.
Amazing teacher and an even more amazing human being. He always goes out of his way to help everyone and has a knack for solving life's unsolvable problems. Saif is a UR legend!

I could write for hours but Saif's easily the best teacher I've ever had. He's very humble, approachable, relaxed, knowledgeable, & understanding. I love his energy & the way he interacts with his students. I called him at 10:00pm on a Tuesday about something outside of his course and he answered so happy to help me. It's impossible not to love him

Mehkari is the best ever. You can't find anyone like him. He stays into the night helping students, always responds to texts and emails, amazing teacher. Take his class if you have the chance. Whatever they are paying him its not enough he deserves a raise! Best teacher and person you will ever meet
Best prof at UR

However much he's paid, it's not enough. He is the best, most genuine, and most caring prof at UR. Will answer phone calls at all hours, responds to emails and texts immediately, and will help you with any issue you have. Advocates for students and just goes above and beyond in and out of class. If you have the opportunity to take his class, do it

Saif if THE GOAT. I have never seen anyone as caring as him. He prepares very clear and easy to understand lecture notes, and make us attempt questions before class and then go over the concept and then check the answers together. He NEVER makes any students feel stupid. Extremely accessible, funny, understanding, and econ MPV. We love prof Saif.

You couldn't find a better professor if you tried. Brings real-world examples into class and will go out of his way to make sure every gets it. Had review sessions before every exam and stayed until midnight helping us study. Goes the extra mile and will help you beyond the classroom. Goes above & beyond for his students and will advocate for them.

Literally the best professor you will have at UR. He is so caring and not only a good professor, but a great person. He makes so much time to support his students inside and outside of the classroom. He makes learning easy #ILoveSaifonomics

Professor Mehkari genuinely cares about his students, and will get to know you on a personal level. His classes are informative and well structured, and full of interesting and humorous anecdotes. He goes the extra mile to be available outside of class time, and provides plenty of resources to ensure that you succeed.
10/10. The best there is.

I think he is the best Professor at UR. Incredibly caring, kind, engaging, and goes above and beyond for his students. His tests are very fair and you will do well if you utilize the resources he's laid out for you.

This class wasn't very difficult, but Professor Mehkari made it spectacular. He is unmatched in both his dedication to the students and his ability to explain concepts in a way for everyone to understand. There is no better person nor professor than Professor Mehkari at the school. If you get a chance to take any class with him, do it.

Hands down the best and most caring professor at UR. His classes are so interesting and he makes the material easy to grasp. He genuinely cares about his students, he is ALWAYS available and will help you study until you feel confident. He once held a review session for an exam and stayed until midnight with us until we understood it.TAKE HIS CLASS
I want him to be my professor for everything. Can't recommend him enough

One of the best professors at UR. Professor Mehkari is extremely nice and caring; he will call you out though if he needs to. He is ALWAYS available if you need help whether with class material or life in general. 

There's a quiz every Monday and weekly homework. The homework is optional but is extra practice so I recommend you do it.

THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER! ECON242 was a journey full of new, extremely useful modern stuff. He is a genius and genuinely cares about his students. His course can be demanding, but he is literally always there to help. Fairest grader of all times. His aim is for students to succeed academically and professionally, not only in his class. TAKE HIM NOW!
He is a great guy. He aims at make everyone in his class get an A.
GOAT

No such thing as a better professor. Personable, understanding, humorous, engaging. All of this along with being an outstanding professor. You could hate econ, but love his class- That is how good he is. Weekly quizzes but not a problem if you do his *optional* homework. Super understanding, relaxed with deadlines. 100% would take again.

If you have the chance to take one of Saif's classes, DO IT. He cares so much about his students, their well-being and their ability to learn. He hosts weekly review sessions and doesn't leave until everyone feels confident in the material. Class is super interactive, homework is easy, quizzes are open-note. You will regret not taking his class.

Thinking about a course with Dr. Saif? Do it! Don't think! Just do it! He makes complicated subjects easy to comprehend, is the kindest human being I know, an advising maestro, calms me down more than my therapist, solves unsolvable problems in my life and always has free food. He is like a swiss army knife!!!!

I wish everyone could at least take one of Saif's classes during your time at UR because you don't want to miss such an amazing professor (he's my favorite). He stays in the review session until everyone's ready for next day's quiz, which is open-book. His tests are more challenging, but you still can get an A if you put effort. Love this man.

The other comments are correct; I don't think I have met a professor as caring. Class is pretty easy and there is very little work. He is also very welcoming and friendly. I felt very comfortable in class.

Saif may just be the best professor at UR. Absolutely hilarious and so helpful. Genuinely cares so much about all of his students and will put in effort to make sure everyone succeeds. Not much work, just two 1-2 page homeworks each week, but can be done during his weekly reviews. Incredible person and teacher and would recommend to anyone.

Saif is simply the best there is. He is an enthusiastic teacher and explains things very clearly. He is also the most devoted and caring professor there is at UR. He really cares about our success and it shows every class!

Dr. Mehkari must be one of the best professors at U of R. He holds weekly review sessions to make sure you understand the material if it didn't click during the lecture. He will communicate with you as soon as he can if you email him, and he will provide an explanation if he does not. If you are struggling in his class, let him know. He will help.
The absolute man.

Cons: Some lectures are boring, and I didn't use the textbook. Pros: He is one of the best professors in all of Richmond, his passion is unprecedented. Sometimes he didn't seem as prepared as other days, but it was because he was also publishing a respected article and working on a heavy economics model, which was applicable/realworld/great for us

Saif puts in so much work outside of class to improve the class experience for his students. He is almost always available on weekends to meet, and his evaluation system is very fair. He has even spent a good deal of time to help me out with a class he doesn't even teach, purely because I offhandedly mentioned a problem I was having.

He's great. The homework is optional, but DO IT because it really helps. He's really accessible outside of class. Replies to emails until at least 10 pm. The tests and quizzes are a fair representation of how much you learned. So if you did bad on a quiz, it's time to learn that material. Don't fall behind.

Saif was by far the best professor I have ever had. He has an aspiration to help his students. He is also very relate-able. He holds himself to get every student to get an A. If you do the homework and go to the study sessions it is very hard not to get an A. This sounds like a lot of work but it is really only 3 to 4 hours a week of work max.

Mehkari was extremely helpful with all the students- he had really late night office hours and would stay until he helped the last student before an exam. Even though my final grade was a C (totally my fault), I learned so much from this class and each session was super interesting. I would love to take this again if I could. Great teacher.
Mehkari was amazing. So helpful, really cares about us students, offered to meet with me to help me work out my b-school major.

Mehkari is the man! I can't say this enough. He is the type of guy who would do anything for a student and I really love his teaching style. Super accommodating but like any class at Richmond, you'll have to put effort in.

He is the best prof this school has. He is unbelievably helpful, offering easy access via email for questions, open note quizzes (but no tech, so have them in paper!), offers a "study group" the night before the quiz (GO!) and goes over what is on it. Will stop class to explain anything in further detail to make sure everyone understands. Fantastic

Hands down the best professor I've ever had. He's teaches because he cares and it shows everyday in and out of the classroom. He won't be the one keeping you from succeeding - if you ask for help and make the effort - show him you care and you're willing to work - he'll help however he can. I don't think I could speak more highly of a professor.

In my 3 years at Richmond, Dr. Mehkari is the best professor I've had. He is passionate about economics; he is thorough in his teaching; he challenges you but gives you all the tools you need to succeed; and he is the most supportive teacher I've ever met. He holds a review session every week and I've seen him in the Bschool at 1am helping students

Best teacher I've had here so far. He is so helpful and is very passionate about the subject. He is always there to help his students, even at 1 am before the exams. He genuinely cares and expects the the best from everyone! The material can be at times confusing but the homework is always like what is going to be on the tests. LITERALLY THE BEST!

Dr. Saif is one of the best professor's you'll come across at this entire school. He stays back till after midnight helping students if required. He's in school all 7 days of the week. His grading is for the benefit of the student. He is never out to get at students, always willing to explain stuff. You'll learn alot from him, not only about macro.
Best professor at UR. Best class at UR.

Saif is extremely smart and very knowledgable. His intro class is a lot of work and some of the stuff is very hard, but his lectures are always interesting and you learn a lot. He also puts in a lot of effort to help his students succeed. Take his class! He is always happy and smiling, and just amazing!

The kindest and most hardworking professor ever. He is the only professor I know that actually wants ALL his students to succeed (and not just the top 2-3 students). He is clear in class and holds weekly review sessions in case someone wants help. He is also very quick with e-mail. Hands down the best econ prof at UR.

The information isn't easy, but he is the most devoted professor I've ever had in regard to making sure everyone is "crystal clear" on the subject. Doing the optional homework and going to review sessions will help a lot, so if you want to do well it's basically mandatory. Take this class, probably the best econ teacher at UR.

Nice guy. His homework is not graded but you have to do it to do well. Each one is over 30 questions and really difficult. Also, once a week he has review sessions where he basically teaches NEW material. For an intro class this was ridiculous.

Professor Mehkari is by far one of the best teachers I've had at the University of Richmond. The material can be challenging but he genuinely puts so much effort in to making sure his students are prepared  and understand the material. He's constantly offering help and will always do what he can to make sure you do well in his class.

Best teacher I have had so far in the B School. His lectures are interesting and so crystal clear that the textbook is not necessary. He aims for every student to understand 100% of the material. He also wants his students to understand the concepts and actually apply them to their career in the business world, even if you're an econ major or not.

I would venture to say that Dr. Mehkari is the best professor at Richmond. Genuinely concerned with students' ability to do well and grasp the material, he regularly stays until 2AM to help/study/review/explain. He does not curve down, rather gives you the highest possible grade and tells you exactly how he derived it. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

Easily one of the best professors at Richmond! He is a teacher who really wants you to understand and learn what he is teaching and will answer any and all questions right when asked no matter what time. Extremely dedicated to teaching. Amazing!

He is an extremely nice and helpful person. Truly cares about his students, he is available throughout the entire night to help. But he is absolutely NOT a fair grader, he curves grades downwards. Whatever grade you expect to receive, subtract a letter grade.

Dr. Mehkari is undoubtedly the BEST PROFESSOR I have ever had. The material isn't easy, but Saif will stay with you until 2AM to make sure you understand. It is not uncommon for him to repeat entire lectures in study sessions if it is necessary. He is extremely knowledgeable, engaging, helpful, and genuinely concerned with students' happiness.

The best professor I have had thus far at UR. His lectures are engaging and easy to follow. He explains things well and is always open to questions. He makes himself available outside of class to with office hours and additional review sessions. The homework is optional and the quizzes are open book. The tests are slightly more challenging but if you study, an A is pretty achievable
Mehkari is one of the best professors I've had. He is an excellent teacher and so willing to help you outside of class. I highly recommend.

Professor Mehakri is my favorite professor in the business school. His lectures are interesting and the workload is manageable. If you study for the quizzes and tests, you'll do fine in the class. He is always willing to help students outside of class if need be and he's a wonderful professor. I highly recommend taking his class!
